title: Small generation of categorical equivalences under filtered colimits
statement: Use the small simplicial sets, quasicategories, internal functor simplicial sets and coherent natural equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use categorical equivalence in the convention of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]: $u:K\to L$ is a categorical equivalence when $h\operatorname{Fun}(L,C)\to h\operatorname{Fun}(K,C)$ is an equivalence of ordinary categories for every quasicategory $C$ in a sufficiently large universe; $hS$ is the category generated by its vertices and edges, with degenerate edges identified with identities and each $2$-simplex imposing the relation that its long edge is the composite of its other two edges. Let $E$ be the class of categorical equivalences between small simplicial sets. There is a small set $E_0\subseteq E$ such that every arrow in $E$ is isomorphic, in the arrow category of simplicial sets, to a small filtered colimit of arrows in $E_0$. The arrow category has maps as objects and commuting squares as morphisms; its colimits are computed at source and target. A small indexing category is filtered when every finite diagram in it, including the empty diagram, has a cocone.
